_readme: TMP_009 iteration 10 — DreamShaper XL Lightning probe (Phase A continuation, content-focused SDXL not character-trained). Same iter 6 prompt verbatim (proven peak 0/9/0), zero LoRA, same fixture. Lightning settings: CFG=2.0, 6 steps, DPM++ SDE Karras. Speed expectation ~3 s/img (≈half iter 6's 6 s). Hypotheses: (a) content-focused dreamshaper base should escape iter 3/9 character collapse trap; (b) Lightning's low CFG=2.0 may weaken negative prompt enforcement somewhat (cf Flux CFG=1.0 needed NAG). A/B target: iter 6 0/9/0 on the same fixture.
